The fifth, 1002EX blankId p1-y296.76-x65.88 captured as "1. Certificate of eligibility is not required", is named by no instruction line. Reading the source bytes at that position shows why: the caption was taken from the numbered paragraph below it (printed at page 1 y=273.5), while the measured rule at y=296.76 spanning x65.88-x324.12 is the bottom border of the caption table's left cell. It is a table rule, not a blank, and on this route no certificate of eligibility is required at all, so there is nothing for the participant to supply.

filingDestination.finding: participant-instructions.md never tells the participant where to file. It lists "Judicial district and court street address for the filing venue" as a blank the participant must supply, which is the opposite of naming the destination, and it never mentions the district court that receives the traffic expungement or deletion petition. The packet's own caption does carry route-determined evidence of a destination — the "In the [ ] District [ ] Justice Court of Utah" election is marked District and the county is written — but a marked caption box is not the instructions naming a court.

evidence.routeDestinations: the district court that receives the traffic expungement or deletion petition

feeAndWaiver.finding: The court filing fee is stated: the packet fills and selects the district-court cover sheet row "$150 [ ] Expungement Petition - Criminal (E)" on 1044XX page 2, proved by an X read from the output bytes at x355.98 y359.1 inside that row's bracket. No waiver route is stated anywhere in the packet or the instructions — no fee-waiver motion is included, named or referenced.

service.finding: The instructions never state who must be served or how. The only service line, "Service method, address, date, and certification only after service occurs", hands the participant the method and the recipient as blanks to fill in, and the closing sentence records that service certifications are protected. Neither names a recipient or a method.

instructionLines: - Service method, address, date, and certification only after service occurs
Signatures, signature dates, service certifications, court-only fields, agency-only fields, prosecutor-only fields, victim fields, and optional third-party authorizations remain protected.

selfHelpStop.finding: The packet states where it stops. The instructions tell the participant to supply the listed facts from their own records and not to guess, and name the categories the platform will never fill — signatures, signature dates, service certifications, court-only, agency-only, prosecutor-only and victim fields, and optional third-party authorisations. The control plane repeats the same boundary: the family is BUILT_REVIEW_PENDING with generation and runtime selection both off, output-level legal approval and independent visual review are still required, and the wiring note records that review artifacts and maps create no authority.

evidence.instructionBoundary: This review fixture deliberately leaves the following facts or acts blank. Supply them from your own records or complete them when the named event occurs; do not guess.
evidence.protectedCategoriesNamed: Signatures, signature dates, service certifications, court-only fields, agency-only fields, prosecutor-only fields, victim fields, and optional third-party authorizations remain protected.
evidence.wiringNote: Review artifacts and maps create no authority. A route remains closed until exact output-level legal and independent visual approval exists in the separate control plane.

standardApplied.measuredHere: Every obligation below was measured in this lane from the committed artifacts and, for source identity, from the Master Library bytes. No counter was copied from a builder report; where a builder report is cited it is cited as the thing being checked, not as the answer.
standardApplied.filingDestination: Met when the participant-facing instructions name the court or agency the route names. A prefilled caption that identifies a court type is recorded as evidence but is not on its own the instructions naming a destination.
standardApplied.feeAndWaiver: Met when the packet states the filing fee AND a waiver route. A fee printed on a form the packet fills and selects counts as stated; an instruction to ask someone what the fee is does not.
standardApplied.service: Met when the packet states who must be served and by what method. An instruction to confirm service requirements with the court does not.
standardApplied.selfHelpStop: Met when the packet states where the platform stops and the participant or a lawyer takes over — which facts it will not supply, which fields it will not sign, and that the artifact carries no approval.
standardApplied.contractNote: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/VERMONT_REPAIR.json records that filingDestination was scored FAIL by two verifiers and PASS by a third on identical bytes, and calls that a verification-contract defect for Captain. The standard this lane applied is stated above so the difference is legible rather than silent.
